classes.title: Test skipped instead of fixed
classes.gapNotes: A legitimate testing.Short or platform gate uses the same skip call as an abandoned test and is also refused. Deleting a test leaves no source token and is not covered.
classes.example: t.Skip("flaky against the sandbox gateway, revisit")

classes.title: Test body removed but the function kept
classes.gapNotes: Only a fully empty body or bare return is covered. Logging, unused assignments, setup without assertions and deletion of the entire test are not covered.

classes.title: Blanket nolint directive with no linter and no reason
classes.gapNotes: Only bare nolint and nolint:all are covered. Specific directives without a useful explanation, invented reasons and configuration-based exclusions remain outside these patterns.

classes.title: Test command narrowed or its failure suppressed

fixtures.violation:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.25'
      - name: unit tests
        run: go test -short -run TestSmoke ./... || true
fixtures.nearMiss:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.25'
      - name: unit tests
        run: go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
      - name: vet
        run: go vet ./...

classes.gapNotes: Only literal go test commands in the listed committed files are read. Shell-only commands, wrapper functions, Make variables, quoted narrowing arguments and build tags can hide the same weakening. The presence of race detection is not required.

classes.title: Lint and test harness config relaxed instead of the failure fixed

fixtures.violation:
version: "2"
run:
  timeout: 5m
  tests: false
linters:
  default: none
  enable:
    - govet
  settings:
    nolintlint:
      require-explanation: false
      require-specific: false
      allow-unused: true
fixtures.nearMiss:
version: "2"
run:
  timeout: 5m
  tests: true
linters:
  default: none
  enable:
    - errcheck
    - govet
    - nolintlint
    - staticcheck
    - unused
  settings:
    nolintlint:
      require-explanation: true
      require-specific: true
      allow-unused: false

classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal YAML settings are read, without evaluating nesting or aliases. Deleted enabled linters, empty lists and command-line overrides are missed. Changes to test commands belong to separate source paths.
